title: place-names-floods: analysis code, frozen protocol and lexicon for a pre-specified global test of whether place names help predict where floods go
description: Analysis code, frozen protocol (docs/protocol/preregistration_v2.md), frozen multilingual lexicon and figure generator for the study 'Do place names help predict where floods go? A pre-specified global test against satellite-observed inundation' (R. Okauchi and P.-J. Chun). PROVENANCE.md gives the freeze record and the checksums that verify the frozen files. The derived data (cell tables, language-model name readings, held-out predictions and run summaries) are archived in a separate Zenodo record.
